name: claude-session-copilot
title: claude-session-copilot
description: Session copilot for Claude Code. Captures decisions, timelines, and patterns across sessions.

discovery.oneLiner: A TypeScript CLI for extending the capabilities of a Claude Code server with session tracking, decision logging, and pattern detection.
discovery.whyItMatters: This tool provides valuable insights into user behavior by capturing decisions made during sessions and detecting patterns in activity. It could be useful for optimizing workflows and identifying areas for improvement within the Claude Code ecosystem.

patterns.name: session-tracking
patterns.summary: The tool maintains a detailed record of user sessions, including timestamps, files accessed, and decisions made. This allows for comprehensive session analysis and reporting.
